fin_gl_actuals.description: Quillmark Bank (fictional) general-ledger actuals, one row per month x cost centre x account, Jan 2024 - Sep 2026 (Q3 2026 closed). amount_usd is positive for both revenue and expense lines; line_type says which. Pre-tax profit = revenue - expense. Synthetic data.

columns.name: month
columns.description: First day of the accounting month.

columns.name: business_unit
columns.description: Retail Banking, Commercial Banking, Private Wealth, Cards & Payments or Corporate Center.

columns.name: cost_center
columns.description: Cost-centre code, e.g. CC-900 (Technology), CP-500 (Card Issuing), CB-300 (Commercial Lending).

columns.name: cost_center_name
columns.description: Cost-centre name.

columns.name: pnl_line
columns.description: Management P&L line, e.g. Net interest income, Personnel, Technology, Fraud & operational losses, Credit loss provisions.

columns.name: account_code
columns.description: GL account: 4100 NII, 4200 fees, 4300 wealth fees, 4400 card fees, 6100 salaries, 6200 technology & software, 6250 cloud & data centre, 6300 occupancy, 6400 marketing, 6500 professional fees, 6600 fraud & op losses, 6700 credit provisions.

columns.name: account_name
columns.description: GL account name.

columns.name: line_type
columns.description: revenue or expense.

columns.name: amount_usd
columns.description: Actual amount in USD for the month (positive).

fin_budget_forecast.description: Quillmark Bank (fictional) plan data at the same grain as fin_gl_actuals. scenario='budget' holds the FY2025 and FY2026 budgets; scenario='forecast' holds the Q3 2026 Reforecast (6+6, prepared 2026-07-20: Jan-Jun 2026 = actuals, Jul-Dec 2026 = forecast). Join to actuals on month, cost_center and account_code. Synthetic data.

columns.name: month
columns.description: First day of the month.

columns.name: business_unit
columns.description: Business unit (same values as fin_gl_actuals).

columns.name: cost_center
columns.description: Cost-centre code.

columns.name: account_code
columns.description: GL account code.

columns.name: pnl_line
columns.description: Management P&L line.

columns.name: line_type
columns.description: revenue or expense.

columns.name: scenario
columns.description: budget or forecast.

columns.name: version
columns.description: Plan version label, e.g. 'FY2026 Budget' or 'Q3 2026 Reforecast (6+6, 2026-07-20)'.

columns.name: amount_usd
columns.description: Planned amount in USD (positive).

fin_kpi_monthly.description: Quillmark Bank (fictional) executive KPIs, one row per month x business unit (Retail Banking, Commercial Banking, Private Wealth, Cards & Payments), Jan 2024 - Sep 2026. Revenue, opex and provisions are the business unit's direct GL totals (Corporate Center costs are not allocated). Metrics that do not apply to a unit are NULL. For bank totals sum volumes; weight ratios by their bases. Synthetic data.

columns.name: month
columns.description: First day of the month.

columns.name: business_unit
columns.description: Business unit.

columns.name: revenue_usd_m
columns.description: Direct revenue, USD millions.

columns.name: operating_expense_usd_m
columns.description: Direct operating expense excluding credit provisions, USD millions.

columns.name: cost_income_ratio_pct
columns.description: Direct opex / revenue x 100 (lower is better).

columns.name: credit_provisions_usd_m
columns.description: Credit loss provisions, USD millions.

columns.name: net_interest_margin_pct
columns.description: Net interest margin %, lending units only (NULL for Private Wealth).

columns.name: loans_usd_m
columns.description: Average loan balances, USD millions (lending units).

columns.name: deposits_usd_m
columns.description: Average deposit balances, USD millions.

columns.name: aum_usd_m
columns.description: Assets under management at month end, USD millions (Private Wealth only).

columns.name: net_new_assets_usd_m
columns.description: Net new client assets in the month, USD millions (Private Wealth only).

columns.name: npl_ratio_pct
columns.description: Non-performing loans / loans % (90+ days past due for cards); higher is worse.

columns.name: nps
columns.description: Relationship Net Promoter Score (-100..100).

columns.name: new_customers
columns.description: New customers acquired in the month.

columns.name: active_customers
columns.description: Active customers at month end.

columns.name: digital_active_pct
columns.description: % of active customers who used a digital channel in the last 30 days.

columns.name: complaints
columns.description: Complaints received in the month.

fin_channel_daily.description: Quillmark Bank (fictional) daily channel activity by region, 2026-01-01 to 2026-09-30. Channels: mobile_app, online_banking, branch, atm, contact_center. For contact_center, transactions = handled contacts, value_usd = 0 and failed_pct = abandonment rate. Branches close on Sundays and public holidays. Synthetic data.

columns.name: date
columns.description: Calendar day.

columns.name: channel
columns.description: mobile_app, online_banking, branch, atm or contact_center.

columns.name: region
columns.description: North, Central or Coastal.

columns.name: transactions
columns.description: Completed transactions (or handled contacts for contact_center).

columns.name: value_usd
columns.description: Total transaction value in USD (0 for contact_center).

columns.name: failed_pct
columns.description: % of attempted transactions that failed (abandonment % for contact_center).

columns.name: unique_customers
columns.description: Distinct customers using the channel that day in the region.

hlt_claim_denials.description: Corvina Health Network (fictional) claim-denial history, denials dated 2025-10-01 to 2026-10-31, one row per denied claim with appeal / corrected-claim outcome as of 2026-11-06. Denial codes are CARC-style (CO-197 authorization, CO-50 medical necessity, CO-16 missing information, CO-29 timely filing, CO-11/CO-4 coding, CO-97 bundling, CO-18 duplicate). Synthetic data, no PHI.

columns.name: claim_id
columns.description: Synthetic denied-claim id.

columns.name: denial_date
columns.description: Date the payer denied the claim.

columns.name: service_date
columns.description: Date of service.

columns.name: facility
columns.description: Corvina facility.

columns.name: department
columns.description: Department.

columns.name: service_line
columns.description: Advanced imaging, Inpatient stay, Emergency department, Laboratory, Physical therapy, Office visit or Outpatient surgery.

columns.name: payer
columns.description: Silverline Health Plan, Pinecrest Mutual, Bluewater Senior Advantage or State Medical Assistance Program (synthetic).

columns.name: denial_code
columns.description: CARC-style denial code, e.g. CO-197.

columns.name: denial_category
columns.description: authorization, medical_necessity, missing_information, timely_filing, coding, bundling or duplicate.

columns.name: billed_amount_usd
columns.description: Billed charge in USD.

columns.name: denied_amount_usd
columns.description: Amount denied in USD.

columns.name: appealed
columns.description: True if an appeal or corrected claim was submitted.

columns.name: appeal_outcome
columns.description: overturned, corrected_claim_paid, upheld, pending or not_appealed.

columns.name: recovered_amount_usd
columns.description: Amount recovered after appeal/correction (0 if none).

columns.name: days_to_resolution
columns.description: Days from denial to final outcome (NULL if pending or not appealed).
